task: Crash-resumable saga coordinator with compensation and write-ahead log (level 17 ports/adapters design)
reasoning_summary: State is derived solely from a write-ahead log, so resuming is just re-running the saga id. Steps are idempotent at-least-once; compensation runs in reverse and returns STUCK (no terminal entry) if it keeps failing. An exhaustive crash-at-every-append test with a ledger oracle verifies recovery.
